def read_bytes(filename, maximum=MAX_BUNDLE):
    path = Path(filename).expanduser().resolve()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
    if len(raw) > maximum:
        raise Problem("Input exceeds its retained-source bound.", 413, "INPUT_TOO_LARGE")
    return raw


def reconciliation_document(filename, case_id, mode):
    """Receive the complete original input and preserve every pending request field."""
    try:
        document = json.loads(read_bytes(filename, 64 * 1024 * 1024))
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise Problem("Use a complete UTF-8 reconciliation input or downloaded desk.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT") from exc
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise Problem("Use the complete reconciliation input object.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
    if document.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.sf47-account-reconciliation-desk.v1":
        if document.get("caseId") != case_id:
            raise Problem("Open this reconciliation desk in its original case.", 409, "RECONCILIATION_DESK_CASE_MISMATCH")
        pending = document.get("pending")
        if mode == "resume" or pending is not None:
            if (not isinstance(pending, dict) or pending.get("caseId") != case_id
                    or pending.get("kind") != "account-reconciliation"
                    or not isinstance(pending.get("body"), dict)
                    or not isinstance(pending["body"].get("requestId"), str)
                    or not pending["body"]["requestId"]):
                raise Problem("Retain the complete original pending reconciliation request.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
            document = dict(pending["body"])
        else:
            draft = document.get("draft")
            if not isinstance(draft, dict) or not isinstance(draft.get("document"), dict):
                raise Problem("The downloaded desk needs its complete editable reconciliation document.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
            document = {"expectedVersion": document.get("caseVersion"),
                        "reconciliationId": draft.get("reconciliationId"),
                        "expectedRevision": draft.get("expectedRevision"), "state": draft.get("state"),
                        "document": draft["document"]}
    elif mode == "resume":
        raise Problem("Resume from the complete original downloaded reconciliation desk.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
    if mode == "preview":
        document = {key: value for key, value in document.items()
                    if key not in ("requestId", "actor", "expectedPreviewSha256")}
    return document


def reconciliation_fields(document, args, applying=False):
    body = dict(document)
    supplied = [("expectedVersion", args.expected_version)]
    if applying:
        supplied += [("actor", args.actor), ("requestId", args.request_id),
                     ("expectedPreviewSha256", args.expected_preview_sha256)]
    for key, value in supplied:
        if value is None:
            continue
        if key in body and body[key] is not None and body[key] != value:
            raise Problem("The supplied " + key + " differs from the retained original reconciliation request.",
                          409, "RECONCILIATION_REQUEST_MISMATCH")
        body[key] = value
    return body


def cash_document(filename, case_id, mode):
    """Keep complete original requests while allowing a downloaded desk to resume."""
    try:
        document = json.loads(read_bytes(filename, 64 * 1024 * 1024))
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise Problem("Use a complete UTF-8 JSON cash input or downloaded desk.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT") from exc
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise Problem("Use a complete cash input object.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
    is_desk = document.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.sf47-cash-desk.v1"
    if is_desk:
        if document.get("caseId") != case_id:
            raise Problem("The cash desk belongs to another original case.", 409, "CASH_DESK_CASE_MISMATCH")
        pending = document.get("pending")
        if mode == "resume" or (mode == "apply" and pending is not None):
            if not isinstance(pending, dict) or pending.get("kind") not in ("command", "correction") or not isinstance(pending.get("body"), dict):
                raise Problem("The desk must contain its complete pending original request.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            body = pending["body"]
            if mode == "apply" and pending["kind"] != "correction":
                raise Problem("Use cash-desk-resume for the retained original cash or source command.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            if pending["kind"] == "command" and body.get("action") not in ("cash.record", "cash.void", "source.add"):
                raise Problem("Resume only the desk's original cash or source action.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            if not isinstance(body.get("requestId"), str) or not body["requestId"]:
                raise Problem("Retain the original pending request ID.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            return pending["kind"], body
        draft = document.get("draft")
        if not isinstance(draft, dict) or draft.get("kind") != "correction":
            raise Problem("The downloaded desk needs its complete editable correction.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
        document = {"expectedVersion": draft.get("expectedVersion"), "selection": draft.get("selection"),
                    "originalCashId": draft.get("originalCashId"), "replacement": draft.get("data"),
                    "reason": draft.get("reason", "")}
    elif mode == "resume":
        raise Problem("Resume from a complete downloaded cash desk.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
    if mode == "preview":
        document = {key: value for key, value in document.items()
                    if key not in ("requestId", "actor", "expectedPreviewSha256")}
    return "correction", document


def cash_apply_fields(document, args):
    body = dict(document)
    for key, value in (("actor", args.actor), ("requestId", args.request_id),
                       ("expectedPreviewSha256", args.expected_preview_sha256)):
        if value is None:
            continue
        if key in body and body[key] != value:
            raise Problem("The supplied " + key + " differs from the retained original correction.", 409, "CASH_REQUEST_MISMATCH")
        body[key] = value
    return body


def ledger_document(filename, compile_sources=False):
    original = Path(filename).expanduser().resolve()
    document = ledger_intake._json(read_bytes(original, 64 * 1024 * 1024), decimal_strings=False)
    raw_defaults = {}
    if isinstance(document, dict) and document.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.sf47-ledger-desk.v1":
        raw_defaults = document.get("rawDefaults", {})
        document = document.get("document")
        if not isinstance(raw_defaults, dict):
            raise Problem("The downloaded desk defaults must be an object.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
    if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get("schema") != ledger_intake.SCHEMA:
        raise Problem("Use a complete ledger-intake document or downloaded browser desk.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
    files = document.get("files")
    if not isinstance(files, list) or not 1 <= len(files) <= ledger_intake.MAX_FILES:
        raise Problem("Select one through twenty original source files.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
    total = 0
    for spec in files:
        if not isinstance(spec, dict):
            raise Problem("Each source file needs its explicit table specification.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
        if "sourceFile" in spec:
            if not compile_sources:
                raise Problem("Compile sourceFile paths with ledger-intake-build before preview or apply.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
            selected = spec.pop("sourceFile")
            if not isinstance(selected, str) or not selected or "\x00" in selected or "contentBase64" in spec:
                raise Problem("Choose one explicit sourceFile path or original contentBase64 for each file.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
            source = Path(selected).expanduser()
            if not source.is_absolute():
                source = original.parent / source
            raw = read_bytes(source, MAX_SOURCE)
            spec.setdefault("filename", source.name)
            spec["contentBase64"] = base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
        if spec.get("id") in raw_defaults:
            selected = raw_defaults[spec["id"]]
            if not isinstance(selected, str):
                raise Problem("Retained table defaults must be JSON text.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
            spec["defaults"] = ledger_intake._json(selected or "{}", decimal_strings=False)
        if compile_sources:
            inspection = ledger_intake.inspect(spec)
            total += inspection["bytes"]
    if total > ledger_intake.MAX_BYTES or len(canonical(document).encode()) > MAX_BUNDLE:
        raise Problem("The complete intake supports twelve MiB of original source bytes.", 413, "LEDGER_INTAKE_LIMIT")
    return document


def publish(filename, raw):
    """Private exact output; an existing destination is never replaced."""
    destination = Path(filename).expanduser().absolute()
    if not destination.parent.is_dir():
        raise Problem("Output directory does not exist.", 422, "OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MISSING")
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="." + destination.name + ".", dir=destination.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o600)
            stream.write(raw); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        try:
            os.link(temporary, destination)
        except FileExistsError as exc:
            raise Problem("Output already exists; select a new filename.", 409, "OUTPUT_EXISTS") from exc
        descriptor = os.open(destination.parent, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
        try:
            os.fsync(descriptor)
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)
    return {"path": str(destination), "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}

"""Import an operator-supplied original source packet into the same SF47 case."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json

from model import canonical, digest, now, text, Problem
from operations import SCHEMA, MAX_SOURCE, generated
import operations_domain as domain

INTAKE_SCHEMA = "scf.operations.source-intake.v1"


def import_source_intake(ops, raw, body):
    """One native transaction; the packet and its exact source texts stay private."""
    if not isinstance(raw, bytes) or not 0 < len(raw) <= MAX_SOURCE:
        domain.fail("Use a nonempty original source intake up to 8 MiB.", status=413)
    try:
        packet = json.loads(raw)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        raise Problem("The original source intake is not readable UTF-8 JSON.", 422, "INVALID_INTAKE") from exc
    if not isinstance(packet, dict) or packet.get("schema") != INTAKE_SCHEMA:
        domain.fail("Select an original SCF operations source-intake packet.")
    interest = packet.get("interest", {})
    if (interest.get("status") != "INTEREST_SUBMITTED_AWAITING_INVITATION"
            or interest.get("full_application_submitted") is not False
            or interest.get("invitation_received") is not False
            or any(packet.get(key) != [] for key in ("grant_awards", "grant_receipts", "customer_revenue_receipts"))):
        domain.fail("This importer handles the stated pre-award source packet. Use explicit case records for later issuer and cash events.", "INTAKE_STAGE")
    original_sources = packet.get("sources")
    purchases = packet.get("purchases")
    if not isinstance(original_sources, list) or not 1 <= len(original_sources) <= 20 or not isinstance(purchases, list) or len(purchases) > 100:
        domain.fail("The original intake source and purchase collections are invalid.")
    checked, seen = [], set()
    for item in original_sources:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("text"), str) or item.get("encoding") != "utf-8":
            domain.fail("The original intake needs complete returned UTF-8 source texts.")
        ident = text(item.get("id"), "Original source identity", 200, True)
        if ident in seen:
            domain.fail("Original source identities must be distinct.")
        seen.add(ident)
        content = item["text"].encode("utf-8")
        if not content or len(content) != item.get("bytes") or hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != item.get("sha256"):
            domain.fail("A source text differs from its original returned bytes.", "INTAKE_SOURCE_CHANGED", 409)
        checked.append((item, content))
    if interest.get("source_id") not in seen:
        domain.fail("The issuer acknowledgement source is not retained.")
    for item in purchases:
        if (not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("participant_classification") != "TEAM_OPERATED"
                or item.get("network") != "stellar:testnet" or item.get("atomic_unit") != "stroop"
                or item.get("decimal_places") != 7 or item.get("source_id") not in seen
                or item.get("included_in_independent_customer_count") is not False
                or item.get("included_in_grant_cash") is not False
                or item.get("included_in_usd_revenue") is not False):
            domain.fail("Preserve the original team-operated testnet purchase classification.", "INTAKE_CLASSIFICATION")
    actor = text(body.get("actor"), "Recording operator", 300, True)
    name = text(body.get("name"), "Operations case name", 300, True)
    revision = domain.integer(body.get("selectedRevision"), "Saved plan revision", 1, 1000000)
    expected = domain.sha(body.get("expectedContentSha256"), "Reviewed plan content", False)
    anchor = domain.calendar(body.get("calendarStart"), "Operational calendar anchor", True)
    captured = domain.timestamp(packet.get("assembled_at"), "Original intake assembly time")
    acknowledged = domain.timestamp(interest.get("acknowledged_at"), "Issuer acknowledgement time")
    packet_sha = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    payload = {"domain": SCHEMA, "action": "intake", "packetSha256": packet_sha, "body": body}

    def action():
        plan = ops.workspace._read(body["planId"], revision)
        if plan["contentSha256"] != expected:
            domain.fail("The selected plan differs from the reviewed source.", "PLAN_SOURCE_CONFLICT", 409)
        pid, stamp, version = generated("operation"), now(), 1
        origin = {"kind": INTAKE_SCHEMA, "packetSha256": packet_sha, "assembledAt": captured,
                  "classification": "PREAWARD_TEAM_OPERATED_TESTNET", "originalPlanId": plan["id"]}
        ops.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_programs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (pid, plan["id"], revision, version, "OPEN", name, "OPERATIONS",
             anchor or plan["planning"].get("calendarStart"), canonical(plan), stamp, stamp, canonical(origin)))
        event_body = {"actor": actor, "requestId": body["requestId"], "note": "Imported exact original pre-award sources"}
        ops._event(pid, version, event_body, "create",
                   after={"planId": plan["id"], "revision": revision, "contentSha256": expected,
                          "sourceSha256": plan["source"]["sha256"], "mode": "OPERATIONS", "packetSha256": packet_sha})

        def append_source(data):
            nonlocal version
            result = ops._source_add(pid, data)
            version += 1
            ops._event(pid, version, event_body, "source.add", after=result, kind="source", record_id=result["id"])
            return result["id"]

        def append_record(kind, data):
            nonlocal version
            values = domain.prepare(kind, data, ops._context(pid))
            version += 1
            result = {**values, "id": generated(domain.PREFIX[kind]), "version": version,
                      "createdAt": now(), "updatedAt": now(), "recordedBy": actor}
            ops._save(pid, kind, result)
            verb = "record" if kind in ("purchases", "cash") else "save"
            singular = {"awards": "award", "deployments": "deployment", "purchases": "purchase"}[kind]
            ops._event(pid, version, event_body, singular + "." + verb, after=result, kind=kind, record_id=result["id"])
            return result["id"]

        packet_id = append_source({"filename": "original-source-intake.json", "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode(),
                                   "kind": "other", "mediaType": "application/json", "observedAt": captured})
        source_ids = {}
        for item, content in checked:
            source_ids[item["id"]] = append_source({
                "filename": item["id"] + ".md", "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(content).decode(),
                "mediaType": item.get("mime_type", "text/markdown"), "sourceUrl": item.get("url", ""),
                "kind": "grant" if item["id"] == interest["source_id"] else "purchase", "observedAt": captured})
        append_record("awards", {
            "stage": "INTEREST_ACKNOWLEDGED", "date": acknowledged[:10], "amountUsd": None,
            "reference": "gmail:" + text(interest.get("original_gmail_message_id"), "Original issuer message", 300, True),
            "sourceIds": [source_ids[interest["source_id"]], packet_id],
            "sourceNote": "Interest acknowledged at " + acknowledged + "; invitation and full application remain pending. No award or receipt is recorded."})
        for item in purchases:
            note = ("Original retained outcome: " + domain.url(item.get("original_outcome_url"), "Original outcome", False)
                    + "\nCanonical source section: " + str(item.get("source_section", ""))
                    + "\nTeam-operated Stellar testnet purchase; excluded from independent customer adoption, grant cash and USD revenue.")
            refs = [source_ids[item["source_id"]], packet_id]
            dep = append_record("deployments", {
                "name": text(item.get("title"), "Original operation title", 500, True),
                "operator": "TJL team-operated demonstration", "operatorId": "tjl-team-operated",
                "role": "BOTH", "participantClass": "TEAM_OPERATED", "environment": "TESTNET", "state": "OPERATING",
                "releaseRef": item["original_outcome_url"], "sourceIds": refs, "sourceNote": note})
            result = item.get("result", {})
            append_record("purchases", {
                "deploymentId": dep, "network": item["network"], "asset": item["asset"],
                "transactionHash": item["transaction_hash"], "ledger": item.get("ledger"),
                "amountStroops": item["amount_atomic"], "deliveredBytes": result.get("bytes"),
                "deliveredSha256": result.get("sha256") or "", "attemptStatus": "ATTEMPTED",
                "settlementStatus": "SETTLED", "outputStatus": "COMPLETE",
                "origin": "SOURCE_SUMMARY", "observedAt": captured, "sourceIds": refs,
                "sourceNote": note + "\nThis is the source-summary capture time. Native attempt/completion timestamps and intent IDs have not been invented."})
        ops.db.execute("UPDATE ops_programs SET version=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?", (version, now(), pid))
        return {"id": pid, "version": version, "action": "intake", "planId": plan["id"], "planRevision": revision,
                "packetSha256": packet_sha, "sources": len(checked) + 1, "purchases": len(purchases),
                "applicationStage": "INTEREST_ACKNOWLEDGED", "grantAwards": 0, "grantReceipts": 0,
                "customerRevenueReceipts": 0, "independentCustomerOperators": 0}
    return ops.workspace._transaction(body.get("requestId"), payload, action)

"""Original SF74 support receiving through the existing SF47 Operations transaction."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
import uuid

from model import Problem, canonical, digest, now, text
import operations_domain as domain

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.sf47-support-preview.v1"
MAX_HANDOFF = 8 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_READER_OUTPUT = 16 * 1024 * 1024
_READER = threading.BoundedSemaphore(1)
HELPER = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name("support_handoff.mjs")


def fields(value, allowed, label):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - set(allowed):
        raise Problem("Use the declared " + label + ".", 422, "SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID")
    return value


def handoff_bytes(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > ((MAX_HANDOFF + 2) // 3) * 4:
        raise Problem("Select an original support handoff up to 8 MiB.", 413, "SUPPORT_HANDOFF_SIZE")
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(value, validate=True)
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise Problem("The original support file encoding is invalid.", 422, "SUPPORT_HANDOFF_INVALID") from exc
    if not raw or len(raw) > MAX_HANDOFF or base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii") != value:
        raise Problem("Select an original support handoff up to 8 MiB.", 413, "SUPPORT_HANDOFF_SIZE")
    return raw


def filename(value):
    value = text(value, "Original support filename", 240, True)
    if value in (".", "..") or "/" in value or "\\" in value or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in value):
        raise Problem("Use a plain original support filename.", 422, "SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID")
    return value


def inspect(raw):
    selected = os.environ.get("SF47_SUPPORT_NODE") or shutil.which("node")
    if not selected or not Path(selected).is_absolute() or not Path(selected).is_file():
        raise Problem("The installed grant runtime needs its Node executable to read the original support product.",
                      503, "SUPPORT_NODE_UNAVAILABLE")
    if not _READER.acquire(blocking=False):
        raise Problem("Another original support review is running. Retry this same review when it completes.",
                      409, "SUPPORT_REVIEW_BUSY")
    try:
        try:
            process = subprocess.run(
                [selected, "--max-old-space-size=192", str(HELPER)],
                input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                timeout=20, check=False)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            raise Problem("The original support reader timed out. Retry the same source selection.",
                          503, "SUPPORT_READER_TIMEOUT") from exc
        except OSError as exc:
            raise Problem("The selected original support reader could not start.",
                          503, "SUPPORT_READER_UNAVAILABLE") from exc
        if len(process.stdout) > MAX_READER_OUTPUT:
            raise Problem("Select a shorter original support capture period.",
                          413, "SUPPORT_REVIEW_SIZE")
        try:
            result = json.loads(process.stdout)
        except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
            raise Problem("The installed original support reader did not return a complete review.",
                          503, "SUPPORT_READER_UNAVAILABLE") from exc
        if not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("ok") is not True:
            error = result.get("error", {}) if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
            code = error.get("code", "SUPPORT_HANDOFF_INVALID")
            if not isinstance(code, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_]{1,100}", code):
                code = "SUPPORT_HANDOFF_INVALID"
            raise Problem(str(error.get("message", "The original support handoff is invalid."))[:1000],
                          413 if error.get("status") == 413 else 422, code)
        native = result.get("result")
        if process.returncode != 0 or not isinstance(native, dict) or \
                native.get("schema") != "stellar-forge.sf47-support-source.v1" or \
                native.get("source", {}).get("sha256") != hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() or \
                native.get("source", {}).get("bytes") != len(raw):
            raise Problem("The original support reader returned a different source.",
                          503, "SUPPORT_READER_CHANGED")
        return native
    finally:
        _READER.release()


def preview(context, body):
    fields(body, ("expectedVersion", "filename", "contentBase64"), "support preview")
    expected = domain.integer(body.get("expectedVersion"), "Reviewed operations version", 1, 10000000)
    if context["program"]["version"] != expected:
        raise Problem("The operations case changed. Refresh it before previewing the support file.",
                      409, "OPERATIONS_CONFLICT")
    name = filename(body.get("filename"))
    native = inspect(handoff_bytes(body.get("contentBase64")))
    source = {**native["source"], "filename": name}
    duplicates = [row["id"] for row in context["sources"].values() if row["sha256"] == source["sha256"]]
    deployments = [{"id": row["id"], "name": row["name"], "operator": row["operator"],
                    "state": row["state"], "sourceIds": row.get("sourceIds", [])}
                   for row in context["records"]["deployments"]]
    result = {"schema": SCHEMA, "caseId": context["program"]["id"], "version": expected,
              "source": source, "workspace": native["workspace"], "metadata": native["metadata"],
              "reader": native["reader"], "report": native["report"], "html": native["html"],
              "retainedSourceIds": duplicates, "deployments": deployments}
    binding = deepcopy(result)
    # These are native calculation timestamps, not retained capture/event dates.
    # All original source times and factual review fields remain in the binding.
    binding["report"].pop("generatedAt", None)
    for side in ("before", "after"):
        capture = binding["report"].get(side)
        if isinstance(capture, dict) and isinstance(capture.get("native"), dict):
            capture["native"].pop("generatedAt", None)
    result["previewSha256"] = digest(binding)
    return result


def _retained_source(operations, context, raw, name, observed_at, media_type):
    sha256 = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    for row in context["sources"].values():
        if row["sha256"] == sha256 and row["bytes"] == len(raw):
            saved = operations.db.execute(
                "SELECT content FROM ops_sources WHERE program_id=? AND id=?",
                (context["program"]["id"], row["id"])).fetchone()
            if saved is not None and bytes(saved[0]) == raw:
                return row
    value = operations._source_add(context["program"]["id"], {
        "filename": name, "mediaType": media_type,
        "kind": "deployment", "sourceUrl": "", "observedAt": observed_at,
        "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")})
    context["sources"][value["id"]] = value
    return value


def receive(operations, context, data, actor, version):
    """Called only inside the original case command's idempotent transaction."""
    fields(data, ("filename", "contentBase64", "expectedPreviewSha256", "deploymentId", "deployment"),
           "support receiving command")
    reviewed = preview(context, {"expectedVersion": context["program"]["version"],
                                "filename": data.get("filename"), "contentBase64": data.get("contentBase64")})
    if reviewed["previewSha256"] != domain.sha(data.get("expectedPreviewSha256"), "Reviewed support preview", False):
        raise Problem("The support source or operations case changed. Preview it again.",
                      409, "SUPPORT_PREVIEW_CONFLICT")
    selected = data.get("deploymentId")
    previous = None
    if selected is not None:
        if data.get("deployment") not in (None, {}):
            raise Problem("Choose the existing deployment or provide a new one.", 422, "SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID")
        previous = next((row for row in context["records"]["deployments"] if row["id"] == selected), None)
        if previous is None:
            raise Problem("Select a deployment from this operations case.", 404, "SUPPORT_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND")
        candidate = deepcopy(previous)
    else:
        candidate = fields(data.get("deployment"), (
            "name", "operator", "operatorId", "role", "participantClass", "environment", "state",
            "costIds", "tranche", "endpoint", "releaseRef", "caseRef", "acceptedBy", "acceptedAt",
            "sourceNote"), "new support deployment")
        candidate = deepcopy(candidate)
        candidate["sourceIds"] = []
        # Validate before creating attachments; the outer transaction also rolls back a failure.
        domain.prepare("deployments", candidate, context)
        count = operations.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_records WHERE program_id=?",
                                      (context["program"]["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        if count >= 5000:
            raise Problem("This operations case has reached its retained-record bound.", 413, "SUPPORT_RECORD_LIMIT")
    raw = handoff_bytes(data.get("contentBase64"))
    html = reviewed["html"].encode("utf-8")
    if not html or len(html) > MAX_HANDOFF:
        raise Problem("Select a shorter original support capture period.", 413, "SUPPORT_REVIEW_SIZE")
    prefix = "support-" + reviewed["source"]["sha256"][:20]
    original = _retained_source(operations, context, raw,
        prefix + "--" + reviewed["source"]["filename"][:170], reviewed["source"]["generatedAt"], "application/json")
    report = _retained_source(operations, context, html,
        prefix + ".runtime.html", reviewed["source"]["generatedAt"], "text/html")
    # Keep a durable relationship even when exact bytes reuse an attachment
    # originally entered through Sources with its own filename and kind.
    before_source = deepcopy(original)
    retained = original.get("supportHandoff")
    retained = retained if isinstance(retained, dict) and retained.get("sourceSha256") == original["sha256"] else {}
    reports = [item for item in retained.get("reports", []) if isinstance(item, dict)
               and isinstance(item.get("sourceId"), str) and item["sourceId"] in context["sources"]
               and context["sources"][item["sourceId"]]["sha256"] == item.get("sha256")] \
        if isinstance(retained.get("reports"), list) else []
    report_link = {"sourceId": report["id"], "sha256": report["sha256"]}
    if report_link not in reports:
        reports.append(report_link)
    association = {"sourceSha256": original["sha256"],
                   "originalFilename": retained["originalFilename"] if isinstance(retained.get("originalFilename"), str)
                       and retained["originalFilename"] else reviewed["source"]["filename"],
                   "reports": reports}
    association_changed = original.get("supportHandoff") != association
    if association_changed:
        original = {**original, "supportHandoff": association}
        operations.db.execute("UPDATE ops_sources SET metadata_json=? WHERE program_id=? AND id=?",
            (canonical(original), context["program"]["id"], original["id"]))
        context["sources"][original["id"]] = original
    source_change = {"before": before_source, "after": original} if association_changed else None
    sources = list(dict.fromkeys([*candidate.get("sourceIds", []), original["id"], report["id"]]))
    if previous is not None and sources == previous.get("sourceIds", []) and not association_changed:
        return {"unchanged": True, "before": previous, "after": previous,
                "sourceIds": [original["id"], report["id"]], "sourceSha256": reviewed["source"]["sha256"],
                "sourceChange": source_change}
    candidate["sourceIds"] = sources
    value = domain.prepare("deployments", candidate, context, previous)
    current = now()
    row = {**value, "id": previous["id"] if previous else "deployment-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
           "version": version, "createdAt": previous["createdAt"] if previous else current,
           "updatedAt": current, "recordedBy": actor}
    operations._save(context["program"]["id"], "deployments", row)
    return {"unchanged": False, "before": previous, "after": row,
            "sourceIds": [original["id"], report["id"]], "sourceSha256": reviewed["source"]["sha256"],
            "sourceChange": source_change}

"""Original SF88 Inbox/Node source receiving in the existing SF47 Operations transaction."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
import uuid

from model import Problem, canonical, digest, now, text
import operations_domain as domain

SCHEMA = "scf.operations.buyer-receiving.v1"
NODE_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.node-operation-accounting-export.v1"
MAX_HANDOFF = 8 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_READER_OUTPUT = 16 * 1024 * 1024
HELPER = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name("buyer_handoff.mjs")
_READER = threading.BoundedSemaphore(1)
ANCHORS = ("network", "asset", "transactionHash", "intentId", "operationId", "requestId",
           "reservationId", "recipient", "acceptedTermsSha256", "firstAttemptAt", "merchantEventId")
OPTIONAL_FACTS = ("transactionHash", "ledger", "feesStroops", "deliveredBytes", "deliveredSha256",
                  "operationId", "requestId", "reservationId", "merchantEventId", "recipient",
                  "acceptedTermsSha256", "firstAttemptAt", "settledAt", "outputCompletedAt")


def fields(value, allowed, label):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - set(allowed):
        raise Problem("Use the declared " + label + ".", 422, "BUYER_INPUT_INVALID")
    return value


def handoff_bytes(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > ((MAX_HANDOFF + 2) // 3) * 4:
        raise Problem("Select an original buyer handoff up to 8 MiB.", 413, "BUYER_HANDOFF_SIZE")
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(value, validate=True)
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise Problem("The original buyer source encoding is invalid.", 422, "BUYER_HANDOFF_INVALID") from exc
    if not raw or len(raw) > MAX_HANDOFF or base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii") != value:
        raise Problem("Select an original buyer handoff up to 8 MiB.", 413, "BUYER_HANDOFF_SIZE")
    return raw


def filename(value):
    value = text(value, "Original buyer filename", 240, True)
    if value in (".", "..") or "/" in value or "\\" in value or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in value):
        raise Problem("Use a plain original buyer filename.", 422, "BUYER_INPUT_INVALID")
    return value


def inspect(raw):
    selected = os.environ.get("SF47_BUYER_NODE") or shutil.which("node")
    if not selected or not Path(selected).is_absolute() or not Path(selected).is_file():
        raise Problem("The installed grant workspace needs its Node executable to read the original buyer product.",
                      503, "BUYER_NODE_UNAVAILABLE")
    if not _READER.acquire(blocking=False):
        raise Problem("Another original buyer source review is running. Continue this review when it finishes.",
                      409, "BUYER_REVIEW_BUSY")
    try:
        try:
            process = subprocess.run([selected, "--max-old-space-size=192", str(HELPER)],
                input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30, check=False)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            raise Problem("The original buyer reader timed out. Retain this same source selection.",
                          503, "BUYER_READER_TIMEOUT") from exc
        except OSError as exc:
            raise Problem("The installed original buyer reader could not start.",
                          503, "BUYER_READER_UNAVAILABLE") from exc
        if len(process.stdout) > MAX_READER_OUTPUT:
            raise Problem("Select fewer original buyer jobs for this source handoff.", 413, "BUYER_REVIEW_SIZE")
        try:
            result = json.loads(process.stdout)
        except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise Problem("The original buyer reader did not return a complete result.",
                          503, "BUYER_READER_INCOMPLETE") from exc
        if process.returncode or not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("error"):
            code = result.get("error", {}).get("code") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
            code = code if isinstance(code, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_]{1,120}", code) else "BUYER_SOURCE_REJECTED"
            raise Problem("The original buyer source needs review: " + code + ".", 422, code)
        report = result.get("report")
        if (result.get("schema") != "scf.operations.buyer-reader.v1" or not isinstance(report, dict)
                or report.get("schema") not in ("stellar-forge.sf88.operations-handoff.v1", NODE_SCHEMA)
                or report.get("source", {}).get("sha256") != hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
                or report.get("source", {}).get("bytes") != len(raw)
                or not isinstance(report.get("rows"), list) or not 1 <= len(report["rows"]) <= 100
                or not isinstance(result.get("html"), str)):
            raise Problem("The selected source differs from the original buyer reader result.",
                          503, "BUYER_READER_CHANGED")
        return result
    finally:
        _READER.release()


def _matches(context, row):
    purchase = row["purchase"]
    if purchase is None:
        return []
    return [value for value in context["records"]["purchases"] if value["state"] != "VOID" and
        ((value.get("intentId") and value["intentId"] == purchase["intentId"])
         or (purchase.get("transactionHash") and value.get("network") == purchase["network"]
             and value.get("transactionHash") == purchase["transactionHash"]))]


def _conflicts(purchase, previous):
    if purchase is None or not previous:
        return []
    result = [key for key in ANCHORS if previous.get(key) not in (None, "") and
              purchase.get(key) not in (None, "") and previous[key] != purchase[key]]
    if int(previous.get("amountStroops", "0")) > 0 and int(purchase.get("amountStroops", "0")) > 0 \
            and previous["amountStroops"] != purchase["amountStroops"]:
        result.append("amountStroops")
    return result



def _historical_node(row, previous):
    if row.get("sourceKind") != "NODE_ACCOUNTING" or row["purchase"] is None or previous is None:
        return False
    observed = domain.timestamp(row["purchase"]["observedAt"], "Original Node accounting observation")
    current = domain.timestamp(previous["observedAt"], "Retained purchase observation")
    return datetime.fromisoformat(observed.replace("Z", "+00:00")) < datetime.fromisoformat(current.replace("Z", "+00:00"))


def _node_links(context, row):
    """Locate the original Node operation without introducing a financial row."""
    if row.get("sourceKind") != "NODE_ACCOUNTING":
        return []
    identity = row["node"]["sourceIdentitySha256"]
    links = []
    for source in context["sources"].values():
        association = source.get("buyerHandoff")
        if not isinstance(association, dict) or association.get("sourceSchema") != NODE_SCHEMA:
            continue
        for link in association.get("rows", []):
            node = link.get("node")
            if isinstance(node, dict) and node.get("sourceIdentitySha256") == identity:
                links.append({"sourceId": source["id"], "sourceSha256": source["sha256"],
                    **deepcopy(link)})
    return sorted(links, key=lambda link: (link["sourceId"], link["jobId"]))


def node_observations(context):
    """Return all immutable source editions, grouped by original operation identity.

    These are source/deployment observations. No value from this view enters the
    purchase, approved-intent, cash, grant-receipt or external-customer totals.
    """
    groups = {}
    for source in context["sources"].values():
        association = source.get("buyerHandoff")
        if not isinstance(association, dict) or association.get("sourceSchema") != NODE_SCHEMA:
            continue
        for link in association.get("rows", []):
            node = link.get("node")
            if not isinstance(node, dict):
                continue
            identity = node["sourceIdentitySha256"]
            group = groups.setdefault(identity, {"sourceIdentitySha256": identity,
                "intentId": link["intentId"], "sourceIdentity": deepcopy(node["sourceIdentity"]),
                "deploymentIds": [], "purchaseIds": [], "editions": []})
            if link["deploymentId"] not in group["deploymentIds"]:
                group["deploymentIds"].append(link["deploymentId"])
            if link.get("purchaseId") and link["purchaseId"] not in group["purchaseIds"]:
                group["purchaseIds"].append(link["purchaseId"])
            group["editions"].append({"sourceId": source["id"], "sourceSha256": source["sha256"],
                "bytes": source["bytes"], "filename": association["originalFilename"],
                "jobId": link["jobId"], "deploymentId": link["deploymentId"],
                "purchaseId": link.get("purchaseId"), "disposition": link["disposition"],
                "node": deepcopy(node), "outcome": deepcopy(link["outcome"]),
                "output": deepcopy(link["output"]), "purchase": deepcopy(link["purchase"]),
                "finality": deepcopy(link["finality"]), "reports": deepcopy(association["reports"])})
    for group in groups.values():
        group["deploymentIds"].sort()
        group["purchaseIds"].sort()
        group["editions"].sort(key=lambda item: (item["sourceId"], item["jobId"]))
    return sorted(groups.values(), key=lambda item: item["sourceIdentitySha256"])


def preview(context, body):
    fields(body, ("expectedVersion", "filename", "contentBase64"), "buyer preview")
    expected = domain.integer(body.get("expectedVersion"), "Reviewed operations version", 1, 10000000)
    if context["program"]["version"] != expected:
        raise Problem("The operations case changed. Refresh it before reviewing this buyer source.",
                      409, "OPERATIONS_CONFLICT")
    name = filename(body.get("filename"))
    native = inspect(handoff_bytes(body.get("contentBase64")))
    report = native["report"]
    rows = []
    for source in report["rows"]:
        matches = _matches(context, source)
        conflicts = _conflicts(source["purchase"], matches[0]) if len(matches) == 1 else []
        operation_links = _node_links(context, source)
        deployment_ids = sorted({link["deploymentId"] for link in operation_links})
        if len(deployment_ids) > 1:
            conflicts.append("NODE_ORIGINAL_DEPLOYMENT_DIVERGENCE")
        prior_purchases = {link["purchaseId"] for link in operation_links if link.get("purchaseId")}
        if source["purchase"] is not None and prior_purchases and (
                len(prior_purchases) != 1 or {match["id"] for match in matches} != prior_purchases):
            conflicts.append("NODE_ORIGINAL_PURCHASE_BINDING")
        if any(link["node"]["sourceIdentity"] != source["node"]["sourceIdentity"]
               for link in operation_links):
            conflicts.append("NODE_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_IDENTITY")
        disposition = ("OBSERVE_ORIGINAL_OPERATION" if operation_links else "NEW_ORIGINAL_OPERATION") \
            if source["purchase"] is None else "OBSERVE_ORIGINAL" if matches else "NEW_ORIGINAL"
        rows.append({**source, "matches": [{"id": row["id"], "deploymentId": row["deploymentId"],
                    "intentId": row.get("intentId", ""), "transactionHash": row.get("transactionHash"),
                    "version": row["version"], "observedAt": row["observedAt"]} for row in matches],
            "suggestedPurchaseId": matches[0]["id"] if len(matches) == 1 else None,
            "currentObservationPreserved": _historical_node(source, matches[0]) if len(matches) == 1 else False,
            "operationMatches": operation_links,
            "suggestedDeploymentId": deployment_ids[0] if len(deployment_ids) == 1 else None,
            "identityConflicts": conflicts,
            "receiving": "CONFLICT" if len(matches) > 1 or conflicts or not source["canReceive"]
                        else disposition})
    result = {"schema": SCHEMA, "caseId": context["program"]["id"], "version": expected,
        "source": {**report["source"], "filename": name, "schema": report["schema"]}, "reader": report["reader"],
        "counts": report["counts"], "interpretation": report["interpretation"],
        "rows": rows, "html": native["html"],
        "deployments": [{key: value.get(key) for key in
            ("id", "name", "operator", "operatorId", "role", "participantClass", "environment", "state", "version")}
            for value in context["records"]["deployments"]],
        "purchases": [{key: value.get(key) for key in
            ("id", "deploymentId", "intentId", "transactionHash", "network", "settlementStatus", "outputStatus", "observedAt", "version")}
            for value in context["records"]["purchases"] if value["state"] != "VOID"],
        "retainedSourceIds": [row["id"] for row in context["sources"].values()
                              if row["sha256"] == report["source"]["sha256"]]}
    result["previewSha256"] = digest(result)
    return result


def _source(operations, context, raw, name, observed, media, kind="purchase"):
    identity = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    for value in context["sources"].values():
        if value["sha256"] == identity and value["bytes"] == len(raw):
            found = operations.db.execute("SELECT content FROM ops_sources WHERE program_id=? AND id=?",
                (context["program"]["id"], value["id"])).fetchone()
            if found is not None and bytes(found[0]) == raw:
                return value
    row = operations._source_add(context["program"]["id"], {"filename": name, "mediaType": media,
        "kind": kind, "sourceUrl": "", "observedAt": observed,
        "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")})
    context["sources"][row["id"]] = row
    return row


def _saved(operations, context, kind, value, previous, actor, version):
    normalized = domain.prepare(kind, value, context, previous)
    if previous and all(previous.get(key) == field for key, field in normalized.items()):
        return previous, False
    stamp = now()
    row = {**normalized, "id": previous["id"] if previous else domain.PREFIX[kind] + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
           "version": version, "createdAt": previous["createdAt"] if previous else stamp,
           "updatedAt": stamp, "recordedBy": actor}
    operations._save(context["program"]["id"], kind, row)
    context["records"][kind] = [old for old in context["records"][kind] if old["id"] != row["id"]] + [row]
    return row, True


def receive(operations, context, data, actor, version):
    """One original command transaction for selected operations, purchases and source."""
    fields(data, ("filename", "contentBase64", "expectedPreviewSha256", "deploymentId", "deployment", "selections"),
           "buyer receiving command")
    reviewed = preview(context, {"expectedVersion": context["program"]["version"],
        "filename": data.get("filename"), "contentBase64": data.get("contentBase64")})
    if reviewed["previewSha256"] != domain.sha(data.get("expectedPreviewSha256"), "Reviewed buyer preview", False):
        raise Problem("The buyer source or operations case changed. Review the retained selection again.",
                      409, "BUYER_PREVIEW_CONFLICT")
    selected = data.get("selections")
    if not isinstance(selected, list) or not 1 <= len(selected) <= len(reviewed["rows"]):
        raise Problem("Select one or more original buyer jobs to receive.", 422, "BUYER_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
    rows = {row["jobId"]: row for row in reviewed["rows"]}
    purchases = {row["id"]: row for row in context["records"]["purchases"]}
    staged, seen, old_ids = [], set(), set()
    for selection in selected:
        fields(selection, ("jobId", "purchaseId"), "original purchase selection")
        job_id = selection.get("jobId")
        if job_id not in rows or job_id in seen:
            raise Problem("Select each original source job at most once.", 422, "BUYER_SELECTION_INVALID")
        seen.add(job_id)
        row = rows[job_id]
        if row["receiving"] == "CONFLICT":
            raise Problem("Resolve the displayed original source or purchase identity conflict first.",
                          409, "BUYER_PURCHASE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT")
        purchase_id = selection.get("purchaseId")
        previous = purchases.get(purchase_id) if purchase_id else None
        if row["purchase"] is None and purchase_id is not None:
            raise Problem("This original unpaid operation has no purchase. Retain null purchaseId.",
                          422, "BUYER_NODE_NO_PURCHASE")
        if purchase_id and (previous is None or previous["state"] == "VOID"):
            raise Problem("Select an active original purchase from this case.", 404, "BUYER_PURCHASE_NOT_FOUND")
        if row["matches"] and (len(row["matches"]) != 1 or purchase_id != row["matches"][0]["id"]):
            raise Problem("This intent or transaction already exists. Select its original purchase.",
                          409, "BUYER_ORIGINAL_PURCHASE_REQUIRED")
        if purchase_id in old_ids or _conflicts(row["purchase"], previous):
            raise Problem("Each selected job must preserve its own original purchase identity.",
                          409, "BUYER_PURCHASE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT")
        if purchase_id:
            old_ids.add(purchase_id)
        staged.append((row, previous))

    deployment_id = data.get("deploymentId")
    previous_deployment = None
    if deployment_id:
        if data.get("deployment") not in (None, {}):
            raise Problem("Choose an existing deployment or provide a new deployment.", 422, "BUYER_INPUT_INVALID")
        previous_deployment = next((row for row in context["records"]["deployments"] if row["id"] == deployment_id), None)
        if previous_deployment is None:
            raise Problem("Select the original buyer deployment.", 404, "BUYER_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND")
        deployment = deepcopy(previous_deployment)
    else:
        deployment = deepcopy(fields(data.get("deployment"), (
            "name", "operator", "operatorId", "role", "participantClass", "environment", "state",
            "costIds", "tranche", "endpoint", "releaseRef", "caseRef", "acceptedBy", "acceptedAt", "sourceNote"),
            "new buyer deployment"))
        deployment["sourceIds"] = []
    if deployment.get("role") not in ("BUYER", "BOTH"):
        raise Problem("Associate the Inbox with a buyer or combined merchant/buyer deployment.",
                      422, "BUYER_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_REQUIRED")
    for row, previous in staged:
        if any(link["deploymentId"] != deployment_id for link in row["operationMatches"]):
            raise Problem("This Node operation already belongs to its retained deployment. Select that deployment.",
                          409, "BUYER_ORIGINAL_DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED")
        if previous and previous["deploymentId"] != deployment_id:
            raise Problem("A later purchase observation retains its original deployment. Select that deployment.",
                          409, "BUYER_ORIGINAL_DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED")
    domain.prepare("deployments", deployment, context, previous_deployment)
    new_count = int(previous_deployment is None) + sum(previous is None and row["purchase"] is not None for row, previous in staged)
    count = operations.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_records WHERE program_id=?",
                                 (context["program"]["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
    if count + new_count > 5000:
        raise Problem("This operations case has reached its retained-record bound.", 413, "BUYER_RECORD_LIMIT")

    raw = handoff_bytes(data["contentBase64"])
    report_raw = reviewed["html"].encode("utf-8")
    if not report_raw or len(report_raw) > MAX_HANDOFF:
        raise Problem("Select fewer original buyer jobs for this report.", 413, "BUYER_REVIEW_SIZE")
    prefix = "buyer-" + reviewed["source"]["sha256"][:20]
    source_kind = "deployment" if reviewed["source"]["schema"] == NODE_SCHEMA else "purchase"
    original = _source(operations, context, raw, prefix + "--" + reviewed["source"]["filename"][:170],
                       reviewed["source"]["capturedAt"], "application/json", source_kind)
    report = _source(operations, context, report_raw, prefix + ".native.html",
                     reviewed["source"]["capturedAt"], "text/html", source_kind)
    source_ids = [original["id"], report["id"]]
    deployment["sourceIds"] = list(dict.fromkeys([*deployment.get("sourceIds", []), *source_ids]))
    saved_deployment, deployment_changed = _saved(operations, context, "deployments", deployment,
                                                 previous_deployment, actor, version)
    changes, links = [], []
    for row, previous in staged:
        if row["purchase"] is None:
            links.append({"jobId": row["jobId"], "intentId": row["intentId"],
                "configSha256": row["configSha256"], "sourceRecordSha256": row["sourceRecordSha256"],
                "purchaseId": None, "deploymentId": saved_deployment["id"],
                "sourceKind": "NODE_ACCOUNTING", "disposition": row["disposition"],
                "node": deepcopy(row["node"]), "outcome": deepcopy(row["outcome"]),
                "output": deepcopy(row["output"]), "purchase": None, "finality": deepcopy(row["finality"])})
            continue
        association = original.get("buyerHandoff", {})
        old_link = next((value for value in association.get("rows", [])
                         if previous and value.get("jobId") == row["jobId"]
                         and value.get("purchaseId") == previous["id"]
                         and value.get("deploymentId") == previous["deploymentId"]
                         and value.get("intentId") == row["intentId"]
                         and value.get("configSha256") == row["configSha256"]
                         and value.get("sourceRecordSha256") == row["sourceRecordSha256"]), None)
        if old_link:
            # This exact received association is historical evidence. A later
            # source may already have changed the current purchase observation.
            # Reopening it must preserve that current record, including its clock.
            saved, changed = deepcopy(previous), False
        else:
            historical = _historical_node(row, previous)
            # A first-time historical accounting carrier remains useful source
            # evidence. Keep the current purchase projection and its actual clock;
            # the new source edition separately retains all original timestamps.
            candidate = deepcopy(previous) if historical else {**deepcopy(previous or {}), **row["purchase"], "deploymentId": saved_deployment["id"]}
            # A later retained source may omit earlier known facts. It does not erase them.
            if previous:
                # The Inbox observes payment/output, not the merchant order lifecycle.
                candidate["orderStatus"] = previous["orderStatus"]
                if row.get("sourceKind") == "NODE_ACCOUNTING":
                    # Accounting carriers do not observe the response file. Their
                    # immutable source output remains NOT_EMBEDDED without
                    # replacing the original Inbox/file observation.
                    candidate["outputStatus"] = previous["outputStatus"]
                    if (candidate["settlementStatus"] == "UNKNOWN"
                            or (previous["settlementStatus"] == "SETTLED" and row["finality"] is None)):
                        candidate["settlementStatus"] = previous["settlementStatus"]
                    # An older or unsigned accounting record cannot undo an
                    # already established original signed attempt.
                    if previous["attemptStatus"] == "ATTEMPTED":
                        candidate["attemptStatus"] = previous["attemptStatus"]
                        candidate["paymentAttempted"] = previous["paymentAttempted"]
                for key in OPTIONAL_FACTS:
                    if candidate.get(key) in (None, "") and previous.get(key) not in (None, ""):
                        candidate[key] = previous[key]
                if candidate["amountStroops"] == "0" and int(previous["amountStroops"]) > 0:
                    candidate["amountStroops"] = previous["amountStroops"]
            candidate["sourceIds"] = list(dict.fromkeys([*(previous or {}).get("sourceIds", []), *source_ids]))
            note = "Original SF88 " + ("Node operation " if row.get("sourceKind") == "NODE_ACCOUNTING" else "intent ") + row["intentId"] + "; retained source " + reviewed["source"]["sha256"] + "."
            if row["issues"]:
                note += " Review items: " + "; ".join(row["issues"]) + "."
            old_note = (previous or {}).get("sourceNote", "")
            candidate["sourceNote"] = old_note if note in old_note else (old_note + "\n" + note).strip()
            saved, changed = _saved(operations, context, "purchases", candidate, previous, actor, version)
        changes.append({"jobId": row["jobId"], "before": previous, "after": saved, "changed": changed})
        links.append({"jobId": row["jobId"], "intentId": row["intentId"], "configSha256": row["configSha256"],
            "sourceRecordSha256": row["sourceRecordSha256"], "purchaseId": saved["id"], "deploymentId": saved_deployment["id"],
            **({"sourceKind": "NODE_ACCOUNTING", "disposition": row["disposition"],
                "node": deepcopy(row["node"]), "outcome": deepcopy(row["outcome"]),
                "output": deepcopy(row["output"]), "purchase": deepcopy(row["purchase"]),
                "finality": deepcopy(row["finality"])} if row.get("sourceKind") == "NODE_ACCOUNTING" else {})})

    before_source = deepcopy(original)
    association = original.get("buyerHandoff")
    association = deepcopy(association) if isinstance(association, dict) and association.get("sourceSha256") == original["sha256"] else {}
    received = {value["jobId"]: value for value in association.get("rows", [])}
    for link in links:
        prior = received.get(link["jobId"])
        if prior and prior != link:
            raise Problem("This exact source job is already linked to its original purchase.",
                          409, "BUYER_RETAINED_SOURCE_LINK_CONFLICT")
        received[link["jobId"]] = link
    reports = list(association.get("reports", []))
    report_link = {"sourceId": report["id"], "sha256": report["sha256"]}
    if report_link not in reports:
        reports.append(report_link)
    association.update({"schema": SCHEMA, "sourceSha256": original["sha256"],
        "originalFilename": association.get("originalFilename") or reviewed["source"]["filename"],
        **({"sourceSchema": NODE_SCHEMA, "sourceIdentitySha256": reviewed["source"]["sourceIdentitySha256"],
            "commandId": reviewed["source"]["commandId"], "contextSha256": reviewed["source"]["contextSha256"]}
           if reviewed["source"]["schema"] == NODE_SCHEMA
           else {"inboxSha256": reviewed["source"]["inboxSha256"]}),
        "capturedAt": reviewed["source"]["capturedAt"],
        "totalSourceJobs": len(rows), "rows": sorted(received.values(), key=lambda row: row["jobId"]),
        "reports": reports, "reader": reviewed["reader"]})
    source_changed = association != original.get("buyerHandoff")
    if source_changed:
        original = {**original, "buyerHandoff": association}
        operations.db.execute("UPDATE ops_sources SET metadata_json=? WHERE program_id=? AND id=?",
            (canonical(original), context["program"]["id"], original["id"]))
        context["sources"][original["id"]] = original
    changed = deployment_changed or source_changed or any(value["changed"] for value in changes)
    return {"unchanged": not changed, "before": {"deployment": previous_deployment,
                "purchases": [value["before"] for value in changes]},
        "after": {"deployment": saved_deployment, "purchases": [value["after"] for value in changes],
            "sourceSha256": reviewed["source"]["sha256"], "selectedJobIds": sorted(seen),
            "unselectedJobIds": sorted(set(rows) - seen),
            "operationalObservations": [deepcopy(link) for link in links if link.get("sourceKind") == "NODE_ACCOUNTING"]},
        "kind": "buyerReceiving", "recordId": saved_deployment["id"],
        "sourceIds": source_ids, "sourceSha256": reviewed["source"]["sha256"],
        "purchaseIds": [value["after"]["id"] for value in changes], "selectedJobIds": sorted(seen),
        "operationalObservationIds": sorted({link["node"]["sourceIdentitySha256"] for link in links if link.get("sourceKind") == "NODE_ACCOUNTING"}),
        "totalSourceJobs": len(rows), "unselectedJobIds": sorted(set(rows) - seen),
        "sourceChange": {"before": before_source, "after": original} if source_changed else None}

def validate_node_import(context, events, reviews, files):
    """Bind restored Node links and source history to the unchanged native reader.

    Existing Inbox source editions retain their original receiving contract.
    Every Node edition is independently re-read from its exact retained bytes;
    current record clocks and frozen historical review values are not rewritten.
    """
    inspected = {}
    sources = context["sources"]
    has_node = False

    def rejected(message):
        raise Problem(message, 422, "BUYER_NODE_RECEIVING_SOURCE")

    def validate(source, snapshot):
        nonlocal has_node
        association = source.get("buyerHandoff")
        if not isinstance(association, dict):
            return
        possible = (association.get("sourceSchema") == NODE_SCHEMA
            or association.get("reader", {}).get("product") == "ORIGINAL_SF88_NODE_ACCOUNTING"
            or any(isinstance(link, dict) and link.get("sourceKind") == "NODE_ACCOUNTING"
                   for link in association.get("rows", []) if isinstance(association.get("rows"), list)))
        if not possible:
            return
        has_node = True
        retained = sources.get(source["id"])
        if not retained or (retained["sha256"], retained["bytes"]) != (source["sha256"], source["bytes"]):
            rejected("A retained Node source edition differs from its complete original bytes.")
        if source["id"] not in inspected:
            raw = files.get("sources/" + source["id"])
            if not isinstance(raw, bytes):
                rejected("The original Node carrier is missing from this complete case.")
            native = inspect(raw)
            if native["report"]["schema"] != NODE_SCHEMA:
                rejected("This Node association requires the original Node accounting carrier.")
            inspected[source["id"]] = native["report"]
        report = inspected[source["id"]]
        if (association.get("schema") != SCHEMA or association.get("sourceSchema") != NODE_SCHEMA
                or association.get("sourceSha256") != source["sha256"]
                or association.get("sourceIdentitySha256") != report["source"]["sourceIdentitySha256"]
                or association.get("commandId") != report["source"]["commandId"]
                or association.get("contextSha256") != report["source"]["contextSha256"]
                or association.get("capturedAt") != report["source"]["capturedAt"]
                or type(association.get("totalSourceJobs")) is not int
                or association["totalSourceJobs"] != len(report["rows"])
                or association.get("reader") != report["reader"]):
            rejected("The restored Node source identity or native reader binding differs.")
        filename(association.get("originalFilename"))
        links, reports = association.get("rows"), association.get("reports")
        if not isinstance(links, list) or not 1 <= len(links) <= len(report["rows"]):
            rejected("Retain the selected original Node source rows.")
        if not isinstance(reports, list) or not reports or len(reports) > 200:
            rejected("Retain the original Node review files.")
        seen_reports = set()
        for original_report in reports:
            if not isinstance(original_report, dict) or set(original_report) != {"sourceId", "sha256"}:
                rejected("A Node review file descriptor is incomplete.")
            selected = sources.get(original_report["sourceId"])
            if (not selected or selected["sha256"] != original_report["sha256"]
                    or selected["id"] in seen_reports):
                rejected("A Node review file differs from its retained source identity.")
            seen_reports.add(selected["id"])
        rows = {row["jobId"]: row for row in report["rows"]}
        deployment_ids = {row["id"] for row in snapshot["records"]["deployments"]}
        purchases = {row["id"]: row for row in snapshot["records"]["purchases"]}
        seen = set()
        for link in links:
            if not isinstance(link, dict) or link.get("jobId") not in rows or link["jobId"] in seen:
                rejected("Each Node source identity must be retained once in its source edition.")
            seen.add(link["jobId"])
            original = rows[link["jobId"]]
            if not original["canReceive"]:
                rejected("The original Node reader requires resolution before receiving this source.")
            fixed = ("jobId", "intentId", "configSha256", "sourceRecordSha256",
                     "sourceKind", "disposition", "node", "outcome", "output", "purchase", "finality")
            if set(link) != set(fixed) | {"purchaseId", "deploymentId"}:
                rejected("The Node association has unknown or missing original fields.")
            if any(link[key] != original[key] for key in fixed):
                rejected("A restored Node observation differs from its original carrier.")
            if link["deploymentId"] not in deployment_ids:
                rejected("The original Node deployment is missing from this case edition.")
            if original["purchase"] is None:
                if link["purchaseId"] is not None:
                    rejected("An original unpaid Node observation cannot become a purchase.")
            else:
                purchase = purchases.get(link["purchaseId"])
                if (not purchase or purchase["deploymentId"] != link["deploymentId"]
                        or _conflicts(original["purchase"], purchase)):
                    rejected("The Node purchase differs from its retained original identity.")

    try:
        for source in sources.values():
            validate(source, context)
        for review in reviews:
            snapshot = review.get("snapshot", {})
            if not isinstance(snapshot, dict) or not isinstance(snapshot.get("sources", []), list):
                continue  # The original review validator handles its complete shape.
            for source in snapshot.get("sources", []):
                if isinstance(source, dict):
                    validate(source, snapshot)
        if has_node:
            for source in sources.values():
                association = source.get("buyerHandoff", {})
                if association.get("sourceSchema") != NODE_SCHEMA:
                    continue
                changes = [event.get("sourceChange", {}).get("after") for event in events
                           if event.get("action") == "buyer.receive"
                           and isinstance(event.get("sourceChange"), dict)
                           and isinstance(event["sourceChange"].get("after"), dict)
                           and event["sourceChange"]["after"].get("id") == source["id"]]
                if not changes or changes[-1] != source:
                    rejected("The current Node source association differs from its original receiving event.")
            for group in node_observations(context):
                if len(group["deploymentIds"]) != 1 or len(group["purchaseIds"]) > 1:
                    rejected("The same original Node operation has divergent receiving associations.")
        return has_node
    except Problem:
        raise
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
        raise Problem("The complete Node source/association history is invalid.",
                      422, "BUYER_NODE_RECEIVING_SOURCE") from exc


def node_report(context):
    rows = node_observations(context)
    if not rows:
        return None
    return {"operations": len(rows), "sourceEditions": sum(len(row["editions"]) for row in rows),
        "unpaidOperations": sum(any(item["disposition"] == "NO_PAYMENT_REQUIRED"
                                   for item in row["editions"]) for row in rows),
        "rows": rows,
        "basis": "Unique original Node operation identities and every explicitly received source edition. Unpaid observations create no purchase, approved-payment intent, cash entry or independent-customer count."}

The original SF47 database retains source selections and recoverable commands.
The configured native accounting workspace owns invoice amounts, documents,
numbers, payment state and balances.
"""

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.sf47-commercial-receivables.v1"
MAX_MINOR = (1 << 127) - 1
BILLING_BASES = ("PHASE_ACCEPTANCE", "COMMERCIAL_AUTHORIZATION")


def _object(value, label):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise Problem(label + " must be an object.")
    return value


def _required(value, label, limit=300):
    return text(value, label, limit, True)


def _integer(value, label, minimum=1, maximum=10000000):
    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= maximum:
        raise Problem(label + " must be an integer in the supported range.")
    return value


def _date(value, label):
    value = _required(value, label, 10)
    try:
        parsed = date.fromisoformat(value)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise Problem(label + " must be a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).") from error
    if parsed.isoformat() != value:
        raise Problem(label + " must use YYYY-MM-DD.")
    return value


def _amount(value, scale, label):
    # Monetary tokens come from original JSON parsed with parse_float=str.
    # Binary floats never enter this conversion.
    if type(value) is int:
        value = str(value)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(
            r"(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,38})(?:\.[0-9]+)?", value):
        raise Problem(label + " must be an unsigned decimal amount.")
    whole, dot, fraction = value.partition(".")
    if len(fraction) > scale:
        raise Problem(label + " exceeds the selected currency precision.",
                      422, "COMMERCIAL_PRECISION")
    units = int(whole + fraction.ljust(scale, "0"))
    if units > MAX_MINOR:
        raise Problem(label + " exceeds the native Receivables amount range.")
    rendered = str(units).rjust(scale + 1, "0")
    return ((rendered[:-scale] + "." + rendered[-scale:]) if scale
            else rendered), units


def _ids(value, label):
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise Problem(label + " must be an array.")
    result = [_required(item, label, 300) for item in value]
    if len(result) != len(set(result)):
        raise Problem(label + " must not contain duplicates.")
    return result

def _review_edition(prepared, milestone, review, edition):
    """Join a frozen issue review to its exact native installation evidence."""
    _object(review, "Original issue review")
    _object(edition, "Reviewed installation edition")
    identity = {key: edition[key] for key in ("id", "revision", "sha256")}
    if digest({key: item for key, item in edition.items()
               if key != "sha256"}) != edition["sha256"]:
        raise Problem("The reviewed installation edition changed.",
                      409, "COMMERCIAL_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    snapshot = edition["preview"]["snapshot"]
    document = edition["preview"]["document"]
    binding = document.get("workshare", {})
    source = prepared["schedule"]["source"]
    if (binding.get("caseId") != source["caseId"]
            or binding.get("planSha256") != source["planSha256"]):
        raise Problem("The reviewed installation identifies another original workshare.",
                      409, "COMMERCIAL_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    evidence = _object(review.get("eligibility"), "Reviewed acceptance evidence")
    checks = {row["id"]: row for row in document["checks"]}
    recorded_checks = evidence.get("checks", [])
    check_ids = [row["id"] for row in recorded_checks]
    authorization_ids = [row["id"] for row in evidence.get("authorizationSources", [])]
    if (len(check_ids) != len(set(check_ids))
            or set(check_ids) != set(milestone["requiredCheckIds"])
            or not set(check_ids) <= set(checks)
            or len(authorization_ids) != len(set(authorization_ids))
            or set(authorization_ids) != set(milestone["authorizationSourceIds"])):
        raise Problem("The reviewed installation omitted or changed its selected evidence.",
                      409, "COMMERCIAL_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    selected = [copy.deepcopy(checks[key]) for key in check_ids]
    original_sources = prepared["sourceSnapshot"]["installation"]["preview"]["snapshot"]["sources"]
    awaiting = [row["id"] for row in selected if row["state"] != "ACCEPTED"]
    expected = {
        "ready": not awaiting, "billingBasis": milestone["billingBasis"],
        "installation": identity, "checks": selected, "awaitingCheckIds": awaiting,
        "authorizationNote": milestone["authorizationNote"],
        "authorizationSources": [copy.deepcopy(original_sources[key])
                                 for key in authorization_ids]}
    expected["evidenceSha256"] = digest(expected)
    if not expected["ready"] or review.get("eligibility") != expected:
        raise Problem("The issue review differs from its original acceptance evidence.",
                      409, "COMMERCIAL_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    return snapshot


def _prepared_specification(prepared, milestone):
    schedule = prepared["schedule"]
    return {
        "workspaceId": prepared["accountingIdentity"]["workspaceId"],
        "customerId": prepared["customerId"], "caseId": schedule["source"]["caseId"],
        "sourceIndex": milestone["sourceIndex"],
        "planSha256": schedule["source"]["planSha256"],
        "sourceMilestoneSha256": milestone["sourceSha256"],
        "currency": schedule["currency"], "amount": milestone["amount"],
        "issueDate": milestone["issueDate"], "dueDate": milestone["dueDate"],
        "billingBasis": milestone["billingBasis"],
        "requiredCheckIds": sorted(milestone["requiredCheckIds"]),
        "authorizationSourceIds": sorted(milestone["authorizationSourceIds"]),
        "authorizationNote": milestone["authorizationNote"],
        "purchaseOrder": prepared["purchaseOrder"], "note": prepared["note"]}


def _same_preparation(obligation, prepared, milestone):
    selected_sha = milestone.get("specificationSha256") or digest(
        _prepared_specification(prepared, milestone))
    return (obligation["specificationSha256"] == selected_sha
            and obligation.get("specificationRevision", 1)
            == milestone.get("specificationRevision", 1))


def _historical_specification(obligation, prepared, milestone):
    selected_sha = milestone.get("specificationSha256") or digest(
        _prepared_specification(prepared, milestone))
    revision = milestone.get("specificationRevision", 1)
    for row in [obligation, *obligation.get("specificationHistory", [])]:
        if (row["specificationSha256"] == selected_sha
                and row.get("specificationRevision", 1) == revision):
            return row["specification"]
    raise Problem("The original preparation is absent from its billing history.",
                  409, "COMMERCIAL_SOURCE_CHANGED")


def _external_command_reference(obligation, intent, missing_sources=None):
    """Keep a foreign prepared case's command identity without importing its authority."""
    return {
        "requestId": intent["id"], "obligationKey": intent["obligationKey"],
        "action": intent["action"],
        "programId": intent.get("programId", obligation["programId"]),
        "preparedId": intent.get("preparedId") or (intent.get("review") or {}).get("id")
                      or obligation["preparedId"],
        "specificationSha256": obligation["specificationSha256"],
        "specificationRevision": obligation.get("specificationRevision", 1),
        "missingSourceIds": sorted(missing_sources or [])}


def validate_import(value, reader=None):
    """Validate the retained source/command graph before the original case import."""
    value = _object(value, "Commercial export")
    if value.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
        raise Problem("Commercial export has an unsupported schema.")
    value = copy.deepcopy(value)
    for key in ("prepared", "obligations", "intents"):
        if not isinstance(value.get(key), list):
            raise Problem("Commercial export rows must be arrays.")
    external_rows = value.setdefault("externalCommands", [])
    if not isinstance(external_rows, list):
        raise Problem("Outside-case command references must be an array.")
    external_commands = {}
    for reference in external_rows:
        _object(reference, "Outside-case command reference")
        request_id = _required(reference.get("requestId"), "Native request identity", 100)
        if request_id in external_commands:
            raise Problem("Commercial export repeats an outside-case command.")
        external_commands[request_id] = reference
    obligations = {}
    for row in value["obligations"]:
        _object(row, "Commercial obligation")
        key = _required(row.get("obligationKey"), "Obligation identity", 64)
        if key in obligations:
            raise Problem("Commercial export repeats an obligation identity.")
        specification = _object(row.get("specification"), "Original billing terms")
        if digest(specification) != row.get("specificationSha256"):
            raise Problem("Commercial obligation hash does not match.")
        if digest({name: specification[name] for name in
                   ("workspaceId", "caseId", "sourceIndex")}) != key:
            raise Problem("Commercial obligation identity differs from its original case.")
        revision = _integer(row.get("specificationRevision", 1), "Billing terms revision")
        history = row.get("specificationHistory", [])
        if not isinstance(history, list) or len(history) != revision - 1:
            raise Problem("The original billing terms history is incomplete.")
        for index, previous in enumerate(history, 1):
            if previous.get("specificationRevision") != index:
                raise Problem("The original billing terms history changed order.")
            prior_spec = _object(previous.get("specification"), "Prior billing terms")
            if digest(prior_spec) != previous.get("specificationSha256"):
                raise Problem("An original billing terms revision changed.")
            if digest({name: prior_spec[name] for name in
